question:
Here some problem or solution of the problem is given in the statement you have to choose the appropriate logical deduction for given statement.

Statement: Urban air pollution has reached alarming levels in several metropolitan cities, prompting governments to implement stricter vehicle emission standards. While electric vehicle adoption is increasing gradually, many consumers still hesitate due to concerns about charging infrastructure and higher upfront costs. Industrial emissions also contribute significantly to air quality deterioration, requiring comprehensive policy reforms beyond just transportation sector changes.

Conclusions:

I. Vehicle emissions are the primary cause of urban air pollution.

II. Electric vehicle adoption faces practical barriers despite environmental benefits.

III. Solving air pollution requires multi-sectoral policy interventions.

Which conclusion necessarily follows?
